Name: Meow Interface
Author: euphonz
Description:
[b]
[size=5]Meow User Interface :3[/size][/b]

A simple B&W recolor of the UI. Goodbye bright oranges and icky browns, Hello coolish (?) greys and baby blues.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/2FNM8v9.png[/img]

Please only install [size=4][b]ONE [/b][/size]version, either the original Meow Interface or the True Grey version.

[b]Requires[/b]

[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
[*]Content Patcher 2.0.0 or later
[/list]

Unzip the file after downloading and drag [CP] Meow Interface [b][size=4]OR [/size][/b][CP] Meow Interface True Grey into your Mods Folder

[u][size=3][b]The brown lines in the farmer profile can be removed by installing a skill mod like the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14142]socializing skill[/url] to get a purrfect ui :3[/b][/size]

[/u]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XwJxveV.png[/img]﻿

As of 1.1.0, Meow UI has a config for cursors and relationship indicators!

Meow UI Cursors
[list]
[*]changes the in-game cursors to the ones that come with this mod
[*]turn it [b]OFF [/b]to use cursors of your choosing; it is [b]ON [/b]by default
[/list]
Meow UI Relationship Indicators
[list]
[*]changes the relationship indicators to the ones that come with this mod
[*]turn it [b]OFF [/b]to use relationship indicators of your choosing; it is [b]ON [/b]by default
[/list]
LG (Light Grey) Elements - [b]ONLY available in Meow Interface True Grey
[/b][list]
[*]changes some font elements and the calendar to Light Grey
[*]turn it [b]ON [/b]to get the Light Grey elements; it is [b]OFF [/b]by default, default is black
[/list]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/H6xbvTQ.png[/img]﻿

The [b]extras [/b]folder has been [b]moved [/b]to the Optional Files tab under the Main Files.

They contain compatibility patches for the following mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791]Better Chests[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11436]Deluxe Journal [/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11158]Smart Building[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3045]NPC Location Compass[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url]
﻿[/list]
Drag and drop the files into the corresponding mods; unfortunately, you have to do this each time a mod updates. Make sure to click replace!
There's a visual in posts tab if you'd like to see how it works :3

Feel free to ask for compatibility patches, and if you do, please link the mod <3

As of version 1.1.1, Meow Interface has a built-in patch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url]﻿
